# Kodiaq

Winner of the 2026 Auto Express Large SUV of the Year, the Škoda Kodiaq combines bold design, exceptional space and everyday versatility. Available with five or seven seats, and selected plug-in hybrid models, there's a Kodiaq ready for every adventure.

## Spacious – for you and all your stuff

With the optional third row of seats, there is still 340 litres of luggage space for up to seven passengers.

When the backrests of the 5-seater remain upright, there is 910 litres of luggage space for up to five passengers.

If you need to load bulkier items, simply fold down part of the 60:40 split second-row rear-seat backrests.

Folding down the rear-seat backrests of the 7-seater increases the total luggage space to 2,035 litres.

Folding down the rear-seat backrests of the 5-seater offers even 2,105 litres of luggage space.

The generously sized luggage compartment can easily hold everything you want to bring with you on your travels.

### Plug-in hybrid available

All 5-seater models of the Škoda Kodiaq are available with plug-in hybrid power. With the ability to run solely on electricity for shorter trips, yet backed by a petrol engine for longer journeys, plug-in hybrid technology offers the best of both worlds, so you're covered no matter the distance.
